product_version: Unassigned future production build; verify v3 rollout first
geography: Existing Slova audience; log geography/source if available
question: Does clear explanation of coin benefits and return to the selected hint increase completion of the original puzzle after an insufficient-balance help request?
hypothesis: Preserving the help context and explaining actual reward sufficiency makes the path useful to the player.
control: Control presentation after the same common readiness/reward durability, truthful economic constraints and exact-attempt recovery/navigation fixes.
treatment: Remaining clarity presentation package: explicit selected-hint price/balance/deficit, guaranteed-versus-random labels and contextual recovery presentation. The common safety and exact-attempt navigation are not treatment-only benefits.
scope: UX package effect; not individual effect of each text or navigation change.
prerequisites: Confirm relevant events from production app version
Fix technical reward/readiness defects in both arms
Verify origin linkage and dedupe from exposure through wallet/hint/completion
Measure baseline primary outcome and eligible-user arrival rate
Freeze horizon, MDE, minimum useful effect, sample size and product guardrail margins before assignment
eligibility: First explicit paid-help request with insufficient balance in a non-free, not-already-owned hint context, with a stable current attemptId and a puzzle never previously completed by the player. Check these conditions before assignment; no need to infer stuck state.
unit: Consenting native SDK-player deviceId string with reviewed continuity/history proof; one first eligible request per explicit measurement phase/eligibility epoch. Installation UUID is a private continuity check, not assignment unit.

assignment.mechanism: Eligibility-gated durable SDK-player assignment at the captured first-request logical occurrence, before actual UI exposure. No generic startup sdk_install assignment.
assignment.exclusions: QA/test/analytics opt-out and ineligible requests defined before assignment

primary_metric.name: original_puzzle_completed_within_window
primary_metric.numerator: Assigned eligible players with durable completion of the exact origin attemptId within the fixed window
primary_metric.denominator: All assigned eligible players whose outcome window has elapsed
primary_metric.time_origin: First eligible help request before UI treatment
primary_metric.clock: wall clock, includes ad wait and background
primary_metric.window_status: Draft: validate against baseline then freeze before experiment
primary_metric.dedupe: one first eligible request per player
primary_metric.identity_and_restart_rule: Freeze origin attemptId before assignment. Resume of the same attempt is eligible; a restart with a new attemptId is not primary success. Exclude previously completed puzzles before assignment because puzzle_completed is deduplicated per puzzle.

secondary_metrics: wheel open per true entry exposure
earned reward to persisted wallet grant
return and selected help use within 10 minutes of grant
guardrails: ad failures and time to readiness
active and wall-clock time to puzzle completion
mature experiment-return D1/D7 after first eligible request/assignment, separately from install-retention
guardrail_return_definition: Exact calendar Day1/Day7 return after first eligible request/assignment, common fixed report timezone, all assigned players with matured windows; do not substitute install-based cohorts.
secondary_analysis_limit: Exposure-conditioned and reward-conditioned rates are diagnostic; treatment may change membership. They are not independent causal estimates. Primary effect uses all assigned eligible players.

sample_plan.reason: The new linked primary metric has not yet been measured; historical rewarded completion is not its baseline.

stop_rules.functional: Stop affected variant on reward loss, duplicate grant, critical crash or broken checkout; investigate data/assignment loss before effect analysis
stop_rules.statistical: Fixed sample/horizon once preregistered; no early winner at first favorable p-value; wait for primary and guardrail maturity
stop_rules.product_margin: TBD before launch; unresolved guards prevent declaring ready
stop_rules.measurement: Assignment SRM/data loss/identity/scope uncertainty stops effect interpretation before causal claims; no post-treatment denominator filtering.
non_incidents: repeated delivery of the same transaction

decision_rules.ship: Valid assignment/data, useful primary effect supported, product guards within preregistered margins
decision_rules.inconclusive: Interval allows useful benefit and harm or sample/horizon incomplete; keep control and decide a new measured follow-up
decision_rules.do_not_claim: More wheel opens or ad views alone do not establish player benefit or retention lift

evidence.limitation: Aggregated historical events are not a causal experiment or baseline for the new primary metric
Local implementation is not proof of deployment

evidence.source: User's hypothesis and proposed contextual UX
evidence.limitation: Player comprehension and causal outcome effect are unmeasured

decisions.decision: Draft one UX experiment after technical fixes and baseline measurement
decisions.reconsider_when: Readiness, grant or origin linkage is unreliable; choose technical diagnosis instead

next_action.action: Keep production phases disabled/null; finish P7 independent review and formal checks. Obtain actual scoped raw baseline/rollout/delivery/identity/history/guard/stop proofs, then explicitly review and freeze trial parameters before any enrollment.
next_action.condition: No experiment launch or spend is authorized by drafting this protocol

measurement_contract.missing_phase_rule: unproven_phase_or_epoch; never infer baseline from missing assignment
measurement_contract.scope_boundary: Do not trim outside-enrollment outcomes, consent facts or conflict alternatives; known legal positives remain valid across consent epochs, absence through proven/potential gaps stays unknown.
measurement_contract.native_context: Operational context only <=24 keys/8192 bytes; phase/assignment/SDK snapshots stay outside receipts.

trial_plan_fingerprint.scope: JS-only original trial request/rejection/assignment/exposure; absent from native receipts and baseline requirements
trial_plan_fingerprint.canonicalization: Shared pure src/core/analyticsKeyToken.cjs; sorted full-config JSON with UTF-16/code-unit object keys and unchanged arrays
trial_plan_fingerprint.missing_or_mixed: Keep all actual scoped SDK assignments in ITT with unknown/bounds; block SRM/effect, never select matching-only cohort
trial_plan_fingerprint.audit: Non-cryptographic lookup token; whole config/evidence/input SHA256 remains separate

measurement_contract.assignment_origin_proof: Known SDK/install plus exact canonical original attempt/content and origin identity, validated before completion/return. Contradictory/unproven context retains original assigned arm and denominator with unknown/bounds; no favorable copy or post-treatment exclusion.

measurement_gates.no_deadlock: Baseline collection needs no prior baseline/MDE/n; trial prelaunch needs no already observed trial SRM or D7. N0 is missing, not safe or statistical failure.

srm.denominator: all actual target scoped SDK assignments, including known-variant orphans; never exposure/ad-conditioned

data_loss.population_denominator: unknown unless independently reconciled; both sides absent cannot be inferred

measurement_gates.complete_reviewed_baseline_rule: No omitted first-eligible SDK units: unknownOutcomes=immatureUnits=0 and firstEligibleSdkUnits===matureN===successes+knownFailures for trial planning. Partial read-only baseline and collection remain independent.

stop_control.local_contract: Locally independently reviewed typed scope/revision controller and bounded monotonic live lease. Missing/stale/unsupported/invalid scope denies trial; disables clamp affected presentation without deleting original ITT or blocking reward recovery.
stop_control.unsupported_loss_crash_proof: closed readiness gate unless independently supplied; diagnostic technical_operation alone is not authoritative proof
stop_control.checkout_proof: Only legal included stage/live/technical-reason shapes bound to reconciled canonical event. Authoritative followup timing/scope comes from that legal fact, never QA/future/quarantined copies; private alternatives may only create possible/unknown.
